_: Caselaw retrieval eval set — 20 landmark Iowa Supreme Court / territorial cases.
Each entry pairs a natural-language description of a case's core legal & factual
holding (the 'query', as an attorney might describe what they're looking for
WITHOUT naming the case) with the decision it should retrieve. The target is a
decision *cluster* path (cl-cluster-<id>); a hit on ANY opinion node under that
cluster (cl-cluster-<id>/op-<id>) counts as finding the case, since the case is
the relevant unit, not the individual opinion.
target_cluster was resolved from the DB by the reporter citation. Two notes:
- Nelson v. Knight: the question set's 825 N.W.2d 4 was the original opinion,
WITHDRAWN on rehearing; the corpus holds the final 834 N.W.2d 64 (2013).
- State v. Ingram: stored as 914 N.W.2d 794 (the question set's 914 N.W.2d 894
is a transposition typo); same 2018 inventory-search case (Bion Blake Ingram).
run: python manage.py eval_caselaw           (scoped to iowa-caselaw by default)

queries.query: Equal protection clause challenge to the statutory definition of marriage restricting it to opposite-sex couples.
Adoption of the Restatement (Third) of Torts; explicitly uncouples foreseeability from the determination of legal duty.
Determines whether a private crude oil pipeline crossing the state without offloading facilities satisfies the public use requirement.
Evaluates whether a second-offense Operating While Intoxicated (OWI) constitutes an infamous crime that strips voter and candidate eligibility.
Rejects federal Fourth Amendment parity; holds that general law enforcement cannot conduct suspicionless searches of parolees under the Iowa Constitution.
Partially abrogates the traditional parental immunity doctrine, allowing minor children to sue parents for negligence outside of core parental authority.
Establishes the definitive multi-factor framework for evaluating joint physical care, emphasizing historical caregiving patterns.
Examines the Right-to-Farm statute; holds that granting absolute immunity to agricultural nuisances violates the state's inalienable rights clause.

queries.citation: 834 N.W.2d 64 (Iowa 2013) [question set cited the withdrawn 825 N.W.2d 4]
queries.query: Decides that firing an employee because they are an irresistible attraction that threatens the employer's marriage does not constitute gender discrimination.
Imposes a categorical ban on sentencing juvenile offenders to life without the possibility of parole under the Iowa Constitution.
Clarifies whether monetary damages are available for direct state constitutional violations, establishing a good faith qualified immunity standard.
Holds that a signature on a standard parole agreement does not constitute valid, voluntary prospective consent to search an individual's vehicle.
Establishes that a co-participant in a recreational sports activity (softball game) can only be held liable if their conduct rises to recklessness.

queries.citation: 914 N.W.2d 794 (Iowa 2018) [question set cited 914 N.W.2d 894, a typo]
queries.query: Departs from federal law to hold that police cannot search closed or zipped containers during an inventory search of an impounded vehicle.

queries.case_name: Luana Savings Bank v. Pro-Build Holdings, Inc.
queries.query: Determines whether the implied warranty of workmanlike construction protects commercial entities purchasing multi-family investment real estate.
First Iowa territorial decision; holds that a slave becomes a free man when he steps onto free soil with his master's consent.
Recognizes a common-law cause of action for paternity fraud, allowing a man to sue to recover child support paid for a non-biological child.
Detailed defense of independent state constitutionalism regarding residential search warrants and rejection of federal exceptions.
Analyzes the scope and enforceability of exculpatory liability waivers signed by spectators entering a racetrack pit area.
Investigates whether corporate directors can unilaterally amend articles of incorporation to dilute the economic or voting rights of class stockholders.
